title: GPU-Accelerated Boids Flocking Algorithm Simulation
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) DataTexture initialization and the compute shader pipeline for GPUComputationRenderer; (2) implementing the three Boids rules in GLSL, requiring iteration over all neighbors (O(n²) parallelized on the GPU); (3) boundary restoring forces and predator escape forces; (4) GPU-to-CPU data readback and InstancedMesh matrix updates; (5) quaternion calculations for orientation; (6) statistical calculations for avgSpeed/avgNeighborDist/centerOfMass
